The List.get() calls may throw IndexOutOfBoundsException if indices are out of range. The casting of long i to int may cause negative indices. Later, buffer.limit(), buffer.position(), and strBuffer.position() may throw IllegalArgumentException or NullPointerException if buffer is null or positions are invalid. The ByteBufferKaitaiStream constructor and io.readBytesTerm() may also throw runtime exceptions.
